description.value: The Prestige Prince George Lodge is part of a family-owned BC hospitality chain with 19 properties across 14 destinations in the province. Sitting on the Cariboo Highway in Prince George, it serves as a gateway stop for cyclists travelling through Northern BC. All Prestige properties are noted as dog-friendly and participate in the chain's loyalty rewards program.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The fetched website confirms Prestige Prince George Lodge as an active, bookable property within the family-owned Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain of 19 BC properties. However, only corporate-level pages were captured (home, careers, blog, rewards, contact-truncated), with no property-specific page for the Lodge visible, so no cyclist-specific amenities can be confirmed from the website. OSM tags provide free Wi-Fi and air conditioning flags, but per evidence rules these cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, and the website makes no mention of Wi-Fi or any other specific amenity for this property.
concerns: Only corporate chain pages were captured; no property-specific page for the Prince George Lodge was available, leaving all property-level amenities unverifiable from the website.
The contact page was truncated before Prince George Lodge details appeared, so phone number and address could not be cross-checked against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active hotel within a well-established BC chain, with confirmed booking functionality. Useful to touring cyclists passing through Prince George on the Cariboo Highway.
